headline._: Quiet. Italy's agency says only 18% of its PHP services are updated.
headline.exec: Nothing new for you. Italy's figure is a reminder: most systems out there are still unpatched.
headline.security: Italy's ACN: 81.9% of PHP services still vulnerable. India: 14% impact rate, above the global average.

items.text: Italy's ACN: only 18% of PHP services updated; 81.9% still vulnerable.
India records a 14% impact rate, above the global average.
